newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 pct - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 pct - traders.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money markets at 3.25 percent, dealers said.
The central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate was bid at 3.25 percent, which is the top of the central bank's 2.75-3.25 percent target range for the rate.

"I just think that someone was holding back on the cash, and someone was left very short, short enough for them to put a bid on the screen at 3.25 percent to get get the bank in," said a T-bill trader with one bank-owned brokerage.
The trader said a second round of specials was not likely.
The three-month when issued T-bill traded at 3.17 percent in the wake of the intervention.
